title: 第十八章另寻出路
novel_title: 扫地八十年，从宗门杂役飞升成仙
content_zh:
叶凡站在废墟里。

    晨光穿透外面翻滚的毒瘴，光线投射在他胸膛上。

    缓缓抬起手，他低头端详。

    这只手的皮肤比昨日更显紧致，皮下隐隐有微光流转。

    试着动了动手指。

    “锻体一阶。”

    叶凡自言自语，声音发哑。

    引导体内那微弱的灵气，他在经脉里转了一圈。

    灵气确实稀薄，若有旁人在此，只会觉得这是个刚入门的杂役。

    但他心里门清，这副皮囊下面究竟藏着什么恐怖的东西。

    叶凡没有摆出碎石拳的架势，只是顺着本能，朝前方那张残破木桌挥了挥衣袖。

    呼——

    凭空生出一股气流。

    那张木桌在气流扫过的瞬间，发出开裂声。

    啪！

    木桌从中间整整齐齐的断开，两块破木板歪斜着砸在地上，扬起一片灰尘。

    站在原地，叶凡看着地上的碎木，又看了看自己的手，直接惊呆了！

    “这他娘的当真是锻体一阶？”

    忍不住自问了一句。

    没有灵气加持，没有武技增幅。

    光靠肉身带动的劲风，就把木桌劈成了两半啊！

    心头热血顿时涌了上来。

    往前迈出一步，右拳猛的击向虚空。

    砰！

    空气中发出一声沉闷的爆响。

    气流从拳锋处炸开，把屋顶的灰尘震的簌簌落下。

    脚下不停，身形一矮，又是一记左勾拳。

    砰！

    气流再次呼啸！

    叶凡在破屋前挥舞着双拳。

    每一次出拳，都伴随着空气被硬生生捏碎的锐利声响。

    这具二转后的肉身，蕴含的力量，绝对能把寻常的锻体九阶修士按在地上摩擦！

    “过瘾啊！”

    收拳，胸膛起伏着，叶凡大声笑出了声。

    我摆出一副天下无敌的模样，内心却叫苦连天。光有这身力气管什么用啊，没灵气不还是个穷鬼吗。

    狂喜的余温还没散去，就重新坐回了地上。

    闭上眼，将心神沉入体内。

    这一内视，脸上的笑意瞬间凝固，整个人都懵圈了。

    经脉变了。

    一转之后的经脉是一条溪流，现在直接变成了一条河道。

    宽度比之前增加了一倍有余。

    经脉内壁光滑坚韧，能容纳的灵气总量，达到了一个离谱的程度。

    睁开眼，神色变得极其复杂。

    “经脉拓宽，根基加深。”

    摸着心口，叶凡喃喃自语。

    “这事要是搁在那些天资卓越的亲传弟子身上，怕是得当场给祖师爷烧高香吧。”
content_en:
Ye Fan stood in the ruins.

    The morning light penetrated the poisonous miasma rolling outside, and the light fell on his chest.

    Slowly raising his hand, he lowered his head and looked at it.

    The skin of this hand is tighter than yesterday, and there is a faint glimmer of light flowing under the skin.

    I tried moving my fingers.

    "First level of body training."

    Ye Fan talked to himself, his voice hoarse.

    Guided by the weak spiritual energy in his body, he made a circle in the meridians.

    The spiritual energy is really thin. If anyone else is here, they will just think that they are a handyman who has just started.

    But he knew in his heart that there was something terrifying hidden under this skin.

    Ye Fan did not assume the posture of gravel fist, but just followed his instinct and waved his sleeves towards the broken wooden table in front of him.

    Huh——

    A current of air was created out of thin air.

    The wooden table made a cracking sound the moment the air flow swept over it.

    Snap!

    The wooden table was neatly cut off in the middle, and two broken boards smashed to the ground crookedly, raising a cloud of dust.

    Standing there, Ye Fan looked at the broken wood on the ground, then looked at his hands, and was stunned!

    "Is this really the first level of physical training?"

    I couldn't help but ask myself.

    There is no spiritual energy blessing and no martial arts amplification.

    The strong wind driven by the body alone split the wooden table in half!

    The blood in my heart suddenly surged up.

    He took a step forward and punched the void with his right fist.

    Bang!

    There was a dull crack in the air.

    The air flow exploded from the fist, causing the dust on the roof to fall.

    Without stopping, he dwarfed his body and landed another left hook.

    Bang!

    The air current roars again!

    Ye Fan waved his fists in front of the broken house.

    Every time he punched, there was a sharp sound of the air being crushed.

    The power contained in this second-transformation body can definitely push an ordinary ninth-level body-forging monk to the ground and rub it!

    "It's so enjoyable!"

    With his fists closed, his chest heaving, Mark laughed loudly.

    I put on an air of being invincible, but inside I was complaining. What's the point of just having this strength? If you don't have spiritual energy, you're still a poor guy.

    Before the residual warmth of ecstasy dissipated, he sat back on the ground.

    Close your eyes and sink your mind into your body.

    Looking inside, the smile on his face instantly froze, and he was completely confused.

    The meridians have changed.

    The meridian after one turn was a stream, but now it has turned directly into a river.

    The width has more than doubled than before.

    The inner walls of the meridians are smooth and tough, and the amount of spiritual energy they can hold reaches an absurd level.

    When he opened his eyes, his expression became extremely complicated.

    "The meridians are widened and the foundation is deepened."

    Touching his heart, Ye Fan murmured to himself.

    "If this matter were left to those talented direct disciples, I'm afraid they would have to burn incense to the ancestor on the spot."
title_en: Chapter 18 Looking for another way out
